gloss: next room; adjacent room; neighboring room

definitions.gloss: next room; adjacent room; neighboring room
definitions.explanation: The room immediately next to or adjacent to a given room. Used for hotel rooms, apartments, offices, hospital rooms, and other indoor spaces.

examples.japanese: {隣室|りんしつ}から{音楽|おんがく}が{聞|き}こえる。
examples.english: I can hear music from the next room.

examples.japanese: {隣室|りんしつ}の{住人|じゅうにん}がうるさくて{眠|ねむ}れない。
examples.english: I can't sleep because the neighbor in the next room is noisy.

examples.japanese: ホテルの{隣室|りんしつ}に{知|し}り{合|あ}いが{泊|と}まっていた。
examples.english: An acquaintance was staying in the room next to mine at the hotel.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}は{隣室|りんしつ}で{行|おこな}われているので、{静|しず}かにしてください。
examples.english: A meeting is being held in the next room, so please be quiet.

notes:
Formal compound of 隣 (adjacent, next to) + 室 (room). More concise and written-style than the everyday expression 隣の部屋. Common in apartment/hotel complaints, mystery novels, and any context where sound travels between rooms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隣室|りんしつ}の{騒音|そうおん}: noise from the next room
- {隣室|りんしつ}に{響|ひび}く: to carry to the next room
- {隣室|りんしつ}の{住人|じゅうにん}: occupant of the next room
- {隣室|りんしつ}との{壁|かべ}: wall shared with the next room

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {隣|となり}の{部屋|へや}: the next room — everyday equivalent; used in speech
- {別室|べっしつ}: separate room — a different room, not necessarily adjacent
- {奥|おく}の{部屋|へや}: the back room — the room further inside
